cim_eredeti: Why LLMs Often Fail Beauty Shoppers
szoveg_eredeti:
As brands wrestle with the task of gaining the attention of human shoppers and winning visibility on generative AI platforms simultaneously, thinking conventionally about optimization is a mistake, said Parham Aarabi, chief executive officer of Pre.

“For most brands, the first thing they think about is: How do they appear more on ChatGPT or Claude or Gemini? And today, this action, which is called GEO or AEO, is offered by every agency and every tech company,” he said in a conversation presented by Pre. But the ubiquity of GEO, or generative engine optimization solutions, does not equate to their efficacy, according to Aarabi. Not only do retailers have unique product page templates, but they also have individual LLMs active on each product page. “For example, Amazon has Alexa; Sephora has AI Beauty Chat; Ulta, Target and Walmart each have their own,” he said. “So, you have to optimize for these local LLMs. It’s a very important optimization, but really hard to do.” blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-ros-mid-article1-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article","mid-article1","btf","in-article1"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[3,3],[2,2],[320,480],[300,250],[6,6],[620,366],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

That puzzle led Aarabi to launch an initiative, starting with a review of 2 million beauty shopping sessions and more than 1,500 beauty-related AB tests. “We wanted to ask if you were to take your existing product pages and put them on each LLM and ask for them to be improved, would they actually be improved?” he recalled. “Would revenue actually go up, or would it go down?”

It was here that the findings seemed to defy logic.

“Our expectation was the most advanced AIs with the most reasoning should be able to do better,” said Aarabi. “We were surprised when the opposite actually happened. It seemed like the more advanced AI, and especially the more reasoning that was applied, the worse the prediction accuracy.”

Frontier LLMs are using reasoning designed for science and coding challenges. Today’s AI “isn’t optimized for beauty product optimization and really understanding beauty shoppers,” said Aarabi. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-ros-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["in-article2","mid-article2","mid","mid-article"] ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[3,3],[6,6],[620,366],[300,251]]) .setLazyLoadMultiplier(2) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

“We decided to build our own reasoning model,” he said. “We would start with an existing state-of-the-art language model like GPT-6, and we would add a reasoning level on top that’s focused on beauty.”

The model Pre developed enables brands to try hundreds of different ideas on a product page and predicts which ones are going to do better.

According to Jacqueline Supman, senior director of digital product management at Tatcha, Pre’s approach helped her brand see immediate value in optimizing product pages for mobile customers.

“Nearly 90 percent of our traffic is on mobile and yet mobile converts at half the rate of desktop,” said Supman. “We had seen a real decline in our add-to-ag on mobile product pages specifically. Pre allowed us to have iterations of tests that would’ve taken my team much longer to come up with when you think of the cross-functional team and time that it takes for alignment, strategy, UX, development and build.”

“One thing that every brand needs today is help with product discovery as well as brand discovery,” agreed Narayan Parasuraman, chief information officer at Unilever Prestige. “One of the things that we saw was with this tool, we were able to actually measure the business value.”

“The user research will help identify the friction points in your user journey experience,” Parasuraman continued. “Then AI helps prioritize that to say, which are the use cases, which are the product pages that we really need to take action on? And then the live experimentation that this offers helps actually get perspectives from actual users.”
